summary_en: Duskin authorized acquisition of up to 1.2 million shares (2.55% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 5 billion yen through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 9, 2026 through March 31, 2027, to improve capital efficiency, enhance shareholder returns, and support share-based compensation plans.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Duskin Co., Ltd. resolved on November 6, 2026 to acquire up to 1.2 million shares of its own common stock through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, representing 2.55% of outstanding shares (calculated on a treasury stock-excluding basis of 47.144 million shares as of October 31, 2026), for a maximum aggregate consideration of 5 billion yen. The acquisition period runs from November 9, 2026 through March 31, 2027. No maximum price per share was specified.

The company stated its acquisition is designed to improve capital efficiency, enhance shareholder returns, and support the smooth operation of share-based compensation programs. The buyback represents a flexible capital allocation response to changes in the operating environment.
